8bitdo-pro-3-bluetooth-gamepad: Liked for build, comfortable grip, precise D-pad and value; a few find the buttons loud or clicky.

gamesir-nova-lite-2: Praised for value, build and comfort; a few find the membrane buttons or Bluetooth latency lacking.
gamesir-tegenaria-lite: Praised as a cheap, comfortable, sturdy wired controller; few real complaints.

razer-blackshark-v3-pro: Praised for sound, positional audio and mic; some feel it is overpriced.

steelseries-arctis-nova-elite: Rated as very comfortable with great sound and a good mic; many find the price the sticking point.
